narrative.intro: National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia has $633M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. The vendor has 1 award recorded this fiscal year and an average award size of $633M. Obligations fell 88.3% year over year. Historical obligations show a multi-year pattern: FY22 obligated $4.3B, FY23 obligated $4.7B, FY24 obligated $5B, FY25 obligated $5.7B, and FY26 obligated $5.4B. The FY2027 total of $633M is a partial, fiscal year to date figure. The note clarifies that all figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Readers should treat the current-year totals as incomplete because FY2027 totals are fiscal year to date. This profile is focused on obligations rather than pipeline value or indirect revenue. Government contractors comparing vendors should align timelines when using these numbers because the FY2027 figure covers only part of the year while prior fiscal years are full-year totals.
